mainQuestExcel.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...

dialogs.text: Where did I go wrong...
What's up?
Traveler... I...
I studied pretty hard after your previous coaching session.
After that, I asked Jack to help me do a mock test.
I... I failed that mock exam.
I'm not sure where things went wrong. Traveler, could you coach me again?
No problem.
Thanks for your help, Traveler!
So... First off, how many people can a single wind glider carry while airborne?
(Uh, did I give the wrong answers that last time...?)

flow.stepDescription: Demonstrate how to use a wind glider to Anna
Demonstrate how to use a wind glider to Anna

dialogs.text: Wow, you're really good at this! No wonder Amber said that I could learn a thing or two from you.
Hehe, with you as my coach, this exam will be a cinch!
Thanks so much! Here, these are for you. I'm off to revise some more!
I wonder what color my wind glider should be...
Blue? Green? Maybe a bit of both, perhaps?
One person per glider.
I see...
That depends on how good the person doing the gliding is.
Huh...
That depends on the weight of the person gliding.
Hmm, I see...
Second question: what should we take note of when using wind gliders?
To select appropriate take-off points and to assume the correct take-off posture.
Oh...
Taking off using Anemo Slimes is always an interesting option.
Is that so...
You need to make sure that you're below the wind glider.
Ah, alright, I see...
Here's my third question, then: what should we take note of when landing?
Select an appropriate landing spot, and do not fold your wind glider in abruptly.
Oh, I see...
You have to mind your descent posture most of all.
Is that how it is...
Make sure to find solid ground to land on.
Hmm, I see...
Hmm... I think I've more or less got it all down now! But I won't get anywhere just by listening...
Traveler, could you give me a demonstration of wind glider usage?
Sure.
I sure will! Let's get going, then!
Watch closely now.
